title: Next Best Evidence Action Planner
goal: Plan which missing evidence would confirm or contradict a hypothesis, rather than selecting the next tool by default.
scope: Planning-only next-evidence-action selection for operator review.
generation_reason: AegisPT should explain the safest missing evidence step, not merely recommend another runner.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement a planning-only next-evidence-action selector. It must not create tasks, dispatch runners, approve proposals, mutate scope, or materialize secrets.

success_criteria: Explains why other actions are lower value.

acceptance_criteria: Planner returns safest next validation evidence with rationale.
Planner uses runner capability metadata while remaining operator-review only.
No tasks, runner dispatches, proposal approvals, scope mutations, or secret materialization occur.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
